title: Multi-modal Data Spectrum

items: Multi-modal Datasets are Multi-dimensional
Madaan et al., ICLR 2026
An audit of modality dependence across 23 VQA benchmarks

note: 通过输入扰动把总体准确率拆成单模态依赖和跨模态交互。论文重点是评测诊断。

title: A correct answer can use a shortcut

items: Question priors can reveal answers when the image changes.
Image content and answer options can reveal a likely label despite an unrelated question.
Benchmark design that removes text shortcuts can accidentally strengthen image shortcuts.

note: 多模态输入不保证模型真正联合使用了两种模态。这里的 shortcut 是基于实验观察的依赖，不是每题的因果证明。

title: Four controlled evaluation conditions
note: 论文使用随机替换而非直接删去模态。“Image only” 仍存在不相关文本，需明确这种实验操作。第 3 节。

title: Dependency strength follows performance changes

items: The adapted perceptual-score method compares normal and shuffled conditions.
Single-modality performance above the random baseline exposes exploitable information.
High paired performance with large drops under either shuffle suggests stronger interaction dependence.

note: 这些量依赖选定模型和 metric。不能把它们当成数据集固有且唯一的信息论分解。

title: Study coverage and model controls

items: The study spans 23 multiple-choice VQA benchmarks.
Domains include knowledge reasoning, spatial understanding, OCR, and charts.
Experiments compare Cambrian scales and other MLLM families.

note: 作者强调最好选择未在目标数据集训练过的 baseline，但现实 checkpoint 的污染与训练明细仍会限制解释。第 4.1 节。

title: Predominantly interaction-dependent cases are rare

items: The paper highlights MME, POPE, COCO, and V* as the clearest interaction-dependent cases.
Several use complementary yes/no questions for the same images.
A single aligned modality often remains informative on the other benchmark families.

note: 这是该实验和模型下的分类，不应写成所有模型永远不能利用这些数据集的单模态偏差。第 4.2 节。

title: Question-only gains above random
note: 第 4.2 节描述的模型评测结果。gain 是相对 random 条件的百分点，不是相对正常多模态准确率提升。

title: Dataset averages conceal category differences

items: Dependence varies within a benchmark as well as across benchmarks.
Larger models can improve total accuracy while preserving shortcut use.
A benchmark label such as spatial reasoning does not establish image–question interaction for every sample.

note: 选择评测集合时应按 category 分层看 shuffle gap，不能只按数据集名字做能力覆盖矩阵。

title: Multiple-choice scope limits generalization

items: Answer options can leak task structure and visually associated labels.
Shuffling produces out-of-distribution inputs and can trigger behavior beyond information loss.
The paper calls for open-ended evaluation and meaningful abstention.

note: 论文没有证明所有开放式 caption 或 agent 任务存在同等偏差。需要重新定义输出与评分协议。

title: Benchmark registry implications

items: Inference: register input permutations, seeds, and answer-option formatting with every evaluation run.
Proposed application: attach a modality-dependence profile to benchmark versions.
Proposed application: compare category profiles before replacing one evaluation set with another.

note: 这样才能区分模型进步与评测集合更换。生产 dashboard 应展示正常分数和三种对照。

title: Code and reproducibility surface

items: The public repository includes benchmark-specific generation and scoring paths.
Normal, Text Shuffle, Image Shuffle, and Random runs produce separate JSONL outputs.
Dataset and model downloads remain external dependencies with their own access and license constraints.

note: 本次静态核查 README，未运行自动下载或推理。复现时需冻结 checkpoint、数据 revision 和随机种子。

title: A practical acceptance test

items: Run all four conditions on a stratified subset with fixed seeds.
Compare per-category confidence, abstention, and correctness under altered modalities.
Promote a benchmark only after its dependence profile matches the capability being claimed.

note: 以上是从研究结论推导的评测流程，不能把 shuffle gap 的改善自动等同于业务任务改善。
